Usage: skills <command> [options]

Manage Skills:
  add <package>        Add a skill package
  remove [skills]      Remove installed skills
  list, ls             List installed skills

Updates:
  update [skills...]   Update skills to latest versions

Add Options:
  -g, --global
  -a, --agent <agents>
  -s, --skill <skills>
  -l, --list
  -y, --yes

Update Options:
  -g, --global
  -p, --project
  -y, --yes

Remove Options:
  -g, --global
  -a, --agent <agents>
  -s, --skill <skills>
  -y, --yes

List Options:
  -g, --global
  -a, --agent <agents>
  --json
